test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 07 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If Z % X # C @ V & B @ N, then how is Z related to B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 &
 %

Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 Husband

to B

 
 
 

Given statement : Z % X # C @ V & B @ N

So,

 
• Z % X → Z is the wife of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0110f06bb7d096581689c3608ca0619fe0bc8ccecea5a685c68317b9a400c4c3.png] 

 
• X # C → X is the brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09884797769624810e3cfa723e1e9b815214578e5e87e42cb2f2cffb141d16b8.png] 

 
• C @ V → C is the daughter of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c59e1f027df1a17b68dd765fe35f47df2e4d9ae637776b426918d6c7bd37e7e.png] 

 
• V & B → V is the husband of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d82ee1048c19faecd0ec39f027a0091c52c19b04a3a56df5f980802840ad759b.png] 

 
• 
 
B @ N → B is the daughter of N.

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/574a14e3a50a0f9aa74870ab3e026df54f92bb2d209bb615da21bba52edb22d1.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Z is the daughter-in-law i.e son’s wife of B.

Hence, **"Son’s wife**" is the correct answer.
